answer: Identity bond decay stops bulk forgery. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond losing 5 credits per epoch, gone in 12 epochs without distinct verified work, like an orchard alive only with tending. Minting 100 fakes costs 6,000 credits, and fakes on tundra ground lapse and forfeit bonds without real work, so bought identities cannot be parked. An honest agent pays once, renews cheaply, keeps undiluted rewards: one pearl, not a sack of fakes.
